bcast/attributable_tier::bigquery:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    customers.tier AS `orders___customers___tier`
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  GROUP BY
    customers.tier
), _cm_orders__customers__spend_sum AS (
  SELECT
    customers.tier AS `customers___tier`,
    CAST(SUM(customers.spend) AS FLOAT64) AS `customers___spend_sum`
  FROM customers AS customers
  GROUP BY
    customers.tier
)
SELECT
  _base.`orders___customers___tier`,
  _cm_orders__customers__spend_sum.`customers___spend_sum` AS `orders___cm`
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_orders__customers__spend_sum
  ON _base.`orders___customers___tier` IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_orders__customers__spend_sum.`customers___tier`
